verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator, so a robot bring-up story is a fair question for it, but the evidence never shows rapid bring-up of a new robot (drivers, configuration, first motion). The pack covers only adjacent pieces: example worlds and pre-built Fuel models, copying SDF snippets, ros_gz installation, and custom plugin development. These are building blocks, not a documented hours-not-weeks bring-up workflow.
